summary: Iter4 tested (a) Elite user login + JWT plan=elite, (b) new 1-click 'Sudah Selesai — Resume Automation' button on Notifications page — conditional rendering + click flow (resume + mark-read + toast + refresh), (c) admin visibility of elite user, (d) regression on all previous 48 tests. Backend: 58/58 pytest passing (48 previous + 10 new in test_iter4_notif_resume_elite.py). Frontend: seeded 3 notifications (verification-unread, gift-unread, verification-read) — button appeared on exactly 1 (unread verification only), click triggered POST /api/automation/resume then POST /api/automation/notifications/{id}/read, success toast rendered ('Verifikasi ditandai selesai — automation dilanjutkan'), button disappeared after refresh. Sidebar shows 'USER · ELITE' badge. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: Notifications.jsx resumeAndMarkRead swallows failure of mark-read if resume succeeds (they are sequential awaits, so mark-read failure would trigger the error toast but resume already ran) — acceptable behavior for idempotent resume, but consider using Promise.allSettled if the intent is best-effort.
Elite plan verification is currently informational only (backend does not gate endpoints by plan). If future paid features are added, add a plan-check dependency in FastAPI.

Seeded 'elite' plan was set via admin PUT after creation — startup seed does not auto-provision the elite test account. Consider adding an idempotent elite seed alongside admin seed for local dev consistency.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted 3 MongoDB notifications with id prefix 'ui-test-' for elite user_id; all cleaned up post-test. Test module also seeds ephemeral 'test-verify-*' notif with pytest fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Elite account (14a6805a-9dfb-427a-82c7-b8b606ce11e5) persists with plan=elite. New button data-testid='notif-verify-done' appears only when notif.kind==='verification' && !notif.read. Click flow verified end-to-end via network capture. All 58 pytest tests green (backend_test.py + iter2 + iter3 + iter4).
